name: Confessions Amongst the Poppies
source:
Overwhelmed by a guilty conscience, Sesame considers confessing their lies, only to be interrupted by a seemingly familiar foe.

[From [url=https://izzycatz.itch.io/confessions-amongst-the-poppies]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
芝麻心怀愧疚，考虑承认自己的谎言，却被一个看似熟悉的敌人打断了。

[来自[url=https://izzycatz.itch.io/confessions-amongst-the-poppies]Itch.io[/url]]
